title: Refresh delegation wait targets left cold after boot hydration retries
outcome: A wait on a delegation whose completed child was left cold during boot can settle without a separate get, result or cancel request.
acceptance: A behavioral regression creates a boot-deferred delegation with a completed child and stored Running status, exhausts inventory hydration retries, then demonstrates that a wait settles without a separate get, result or cancel request.

Wait registration hydrates and refreshes its targets off-lock, or an equivalent bounded recovery mechanism settles skipped delegations; genuinely running delegations remain pending and corruption isolation and stale-capture fences remain intact.
